Elden Ring.shortDescription: FromSoftware's open-world action RPG. Forge your path through the Lands Between with challenging combat, deep lore, and legendary bosses.

Cyberpunk 2077.shortDescription: Immersive open-world RPG in Night City. Play as V, customize with cyberware, and shape your story through choices and intense action.

God of War Ragnarok.shortDescription: Kratos and Atreus return in an emotional, action-packed journey through Norse realms. Cinematic storytelling meets brutal combat.

The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdo.shortDescription: Link explores the skies and depths of Hyrule. Build, solve puzzles, and discover secrets in a vast open world.

Super Mario Odyssey.shortDescription: Mario travels the world with Cappy in a joyful platforming adventure. Capture enemies, solve puzzles, and explore vibrant kingdoms.

Halo Infinite.shortDescription: Master Chief returns in a sci-fi FPS. Expansive campaign and fast-paced multiplayer on the Halo ring.

Forza Horizon 5.shortDescription: Open-world racing across Mexico. Hundreds of cars, dynamic seasons, and endless events in stunning landscapes.

Marvel's Spider-Man 2.shortDescription: Swing through New York as Peter and Miles. Fluid combat, cinematic story, and a vibrant open world full of secrets.

Baldur's Gate 3.shortDescription: D&D-inspired RPG where your choices shape everything. Tactical turn-based combat, deep story, and memorable companions.

Red Dead Redemption 2.shortDescription: Epic Western tale of Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang. A vast, immersive open world of loyalty and redemption.

The Last of Us Part II.shortDescription: Ellie's emotional journey through a post-apocalyptic world. Stealth, survival, and a story of revenge and humanity.

Animal Crossing: New Horizons.shortDescription: Build your dream island, decorate, and befriend animal villagers. A relaxing life sim with fishing, bugs, and seasonal events.

Grand Theft Auto V.shortDescription: Three protagonists, Los Santos, and endless action. Heists, missions, and a massive online world.

EA Sports FC 24.shortDescription: Realistic football with authentic teams and leagues. Build your squad and compete online or in career mode.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.shortDescription: Intense modern combat with a gripping campaign and competitive multiplayer. Refined gunplay and tactical options.

Diablo IV.shortDescription: Action RPG in Sanctuary. Slay demons, choose your class, and chase loot in a shared open world with seasons.

Hogwarts Legacy.shortDescription: Attend Hogwarts in the 1800s. Learn spells, explore the wizarding world, and shape your own magical destiny.

Resident Evil 4 Remake.shortDescription: Leon S. Kennedy's mission reimagined. Survival horror with refined combat, puzzles, and tense encounters.

Metroid Dread.shortDescription: Samus Aran in a side-scrolling action adventure. Explore, upgrade, and evade relentless enemies in a suspenseful journey.

Starfield.shortDescription: Bethesda's space RPG. Explore star systems, pilot ships, and shape your path in a vast sci-fi universe.

Final Fantasy XVI.shortDescription: Dramatic fantasy where Eikons shape fate. Real-time action combat, political intrigue, and epic set pieces.

Mario Kart 8 Deluxe.shortDescription: Race with Mario and friends. Colorful tracks, power-ups, and battle modes for local and online multiplayer.

Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice.shortDescription: Precise sword combat in feudal Japan. A shinobi's revenge with demanding bosses and rewarding skill-based gameplay.

Horizon Forbidden West.shortDescription: Aloy explores the Forbidden West. Robotic creatures, ancient mysteries, and strategic combat in a stunning open world.

Sea of Thieves.shortDescription: Shared-world pirate adventure. Sail, hunt treasure, battle crews, and face mythical creatures solo or with friends.

Stardew Valley.shortDescription: Farm, mine, fish, and befriend the valley. A charming simulation with cozy progression and seasonal events.

Monster Hunter Rise.shortDescription: Hunt massive monsters with strategic combat and wirebugs. Solo or co-op, craft gear and master your weapon.

Dead Space Remake.shortDescription: Survive the USG Ishimura in this sci-fi horror remake. Isaac Clarke faces necromorphs in tense, atmospheric combat.

Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart.shortDescription: Dimension-hopping action with Ratchet and Rivet. Creative weapons, vibrant worlds, and seamless reality-shifting gameplay.

Hollow Knight.shortDescription: Explore a haunting insect kingdom in this Metroidvania. Precise combat, hidden paths, and deep lore to discover.
